about: The router's table: which models answer which delegated task, and the JSON schema each answer must meet. tools/models-delegate.mjs reads it. Open-weight models first, chosen from round 1 of the evals (models/results.json: the cheapest models right on every item of that task, from the Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral and Gemma families); one commercial model beside them for comparison, labelled as such. A delegated answer is evidence, labelled with the model's name, until the calling agent's own check passes.
label: hypothesis
source: models/results.json (round 1); Dinis, 11 November ~22:00 UTC (BRIEF.md): collectors through OpenRouter, open-source models, at least a couple

budget.agent_share: each calling agent's own share in models/budgets.json; the delegation as a whole within the 5 USD of 'delegation'

translate.for: incident.transport@: an English summary of each new Portuguese operator notice

comparison.why: a commercial model for comparison (Dinis: "from Gemini to different type of providers"); never the one whose answer is used

evidence.translate: 20/20 for google/gemma-4-31b-it and meta-llama/llama-4-maverick (figures and units kept)
evidence.changed: 22:34 UTC: qwen/qwen3.5-9b (reasoning off) replaced by google/gemma-4-31b-it after transport's first run: 3 of its answers to the notice prompt were not one JSON object and had to be asked again (models/delegated/summary.json)

translate.check: figures: every number in the Portuguese is in the English

extract-warning.for: incident.sources@ or incident.weatherwatch@: the fields of each new IPMA CAP message, compared with their own parser

comparison.why: a commercial model for comparison (Dinis: "from Gemini to different type of providers"); never the one whose answer is used

extract-warning.check: the owner's parser on the same message: any field that differs is the parser's value, and the difference is reported

extract-decision.for: incident.researcher@: the decision in a press or official passage

comparison.why: a commercial model for comparison (Dinis: "from Gemini to different type of providers"); never the one whose answer is used

extract-decision.check: the decider and hours against the primary source's own page; a press item is never the decision itself

label.for: incident.media@ (and the lead): fact, evidence or hypothesis for a row or a press item, as a second reader

comparison.why: a commercial model for comparison (Dinis: "from Gemini to different type of providers"); never the one whose answer is used

label.check: never the labeller: flagged for the owner only when both open models disagree with the owner's label

match-fact.for: incident.media@: which of the team's facts (research/media/facts.json, each read on its primary source) a press headline reports, compared with its own patterns

comparison.why: a commercial model for comparison (Dinis: "from Gemini to different type of providers"); never the one whose answer is used

evidence.label: 17/20 for both on the nearest measured task (label); match-fact itself is not yet measured: the owner's patterns are the reference

match-fact.check: the fact id must be one of the list or none; the owner's own pattern on the same headline is the reference, and a headline the models and the pattern disagree on is listed for the owner, never relabelled
